subject: ddl: do not reference owner_id for specific system DDL (#53332)
summary: Reviewed the first-parent diff in `pkg/ddl` (MDL info registration/cleanup). The change special-cases DDLs targeting `mysql.tidb_mdl_info` to avoid referencing `owner_id`, preventing upgrade-time circular failures while keeping normal DDL MDL semantics unchanged. Checked later upstream history; follow-up generalized this to all system-DB DDLs, and no remaining Blocker/High issues were found in correctness, consistency, concurrency, or DDL metadata/state-machine handling.
